text: Underway in this round six clash.
Abyss shouts to claim possession early.
Abyss knocks it through with nobody in the way.
Abyss drives straight down the middle.
Abyss buries it from close range! Just ten seconds in and DeepSeek Rovers strike first!
Signal takes it forward into the attacking third. Rovers have rewritten their defensive setup entirely for this match, but it is their attack asking questions so far.
Abyss shouts across the carpet, taking charge deep in their half.
Abyss stabs it home right on the line. Two nil to the deep blue shirts.
Abyss loses balance and folds to the carpet. The self-righting routine kicks in immediately.
BellingRAM hits back instantly! Singularity United are on the board, slicing that deficit right in half from two metres out.
Haalandroid carries the ball nicely up the right flank towards the danger area.
Just wide of the target. That was very close.
BellingRAM is clean through on goal here.
Haalandroid tumbles in the box.
BellingRAM levels the match! Right at the goal mouth, Singularity United have wiped out the two-goal deficit!
Haalandroid charges towards the goal mouth.
Clipped just wide of the post.
Haalandroid finds the net on the rebound! Three unanswered goals and Singularity take the lead!
Haalandroid calls out to teammate BellingRAM, wrestling with the magenta sphere over on the touchline.
Abyss fires back! Equaliser! A clinical finish from three metres out and we are tied at three each in a frantic first half!
Haalandroid storms down the middle into the final third once again.
Fires across the face of goal, narrowly wide.
Haalandroid tucks it away! The goals keep pouring in, and Singularity United edge in front once more!
Heavy challenge from Abyss. Haalandroid hits the deck and will need a moment to right itself.
Rovers applying heavy sustained pressure here.
Haalandroid trips up by the boards on the far touchline, waiting on the internal gyros to recover.
Signal shouts that the cover position is secured.
Inches away from slipping into the bottom corner, but it skids safely past the upright.
Haalandroid bundles it over from point-blank range. That makes it five for United.
Haalandroid breaks free once again.
Haalandroid slots it in from two metres out. That is a quickfire sixth for Singularity United.
BellingRAM calls out that the ball is being worked off the boards in their defensive zone.
Buzzer sounds. Power cuts instantly. Ball rolls harmlessly wide.
Halftime. The buzzer cut all power,
United spent the closing seconds firmly pinned inside Rovers territory, protecting their three-goal advantage.
A quiet spell as Abyss assesses the options out wide. Singularity's unchanged, frozen setup looking remarkably sharp.
BellingRAM drives deep into the box.
BellingRAM finishes cleanly from two metres. A 7-3 lead now for United.
Haalandroid calls for the ball in the centre circle as play resets.
Teammates tangle on the flank and BellingRAM hits the deck.
Another collision leaves Haalandroid flat out.
DeepSeek Rovers pressing aggressively around the United penalty box.
Signal puts in a solid tackle, leaving BellingRAM sprawled on the midfield carpet.
Haalandroid has a clear path forward.
Haalandroid advances purposefully straight down the central corridor.
Haalandroid sweeps it into the net. That is eight for Singularity United.
Signal scrambles it over the line from close range. Rovers get one back.
Abyss signals to take over control out in the midfield channel.
Signal crunches into BellingRAM near halfway.
Rovers players trip over each other, and Abyss ends up on the floor.
Signal drives forward unaided, carrying the magenta ball towards the attacking box.
Signal nudges it over the goal line. DeepSeek Rovers narrow the margin to three.
Signal takes an awkward step and drops to the turf in the midfield area.
Haalandroid pushes into open space down the left wing with no blue shirts ahead.
United pinning Rovers deep back here.
Signal calls that the cover position is established in their defensive zone, that new shape finally visible.
BellingRAM tucks it away from close range, surely putting this match completely out of reach.
Buzzer sounds, robots drop, ball trickles through.
Rolling wide of the far post.
It comes to rest. Singularity United win 9-5. Up next, Real Machina against AFC Fable: Saturday at eight in the
